title: Placeholder: yEnc encoding and decoding for binary articles (deferred to v2)
description:
Design placeholder for yEnc support in v2. yEnc is the de facto encoding for binary Usenet articles. In v2, the reader daemon will need to decode yEnc-encoded articles posted by standard newsreader clients and re-encode them if needed. This is explicitly out of scope for v1. Artifact: notes in this issue only.
